verdicts.reason: A breaks the design. The photo stops about 60px short of the right edge. A huge dead white band fills the middle. The white heart now sits on a white background, so it shows only as a faint outline and no longer works as a cutout over the bed. The headline and URL are pushed to the bottom, cut off from the image. B is just the original shrunk and letterboxed, with large empty white bands top and bottom and smaller, hard-to-read text, so it doesn't use the tall format. Still, the heart-over-photo composition, the hierarchy and the brand feel all come through intact.
